title: The Green Gym Bathroom
content: Hey everyone, I apologize if this is all over the place, I’m new to this and still trying to figure out the details. I wanted to post an image I had Gemini AI create for me of a gym bathroom that may or may not exist in Mall World. I’ve seen this bathroom in recurring dreams and it feels so real. Basic description is a dimly lit locker room where the walls are white, the floor is grey tile, and the lockers and bathroom stalls are forest green. The lighting is flickering fluorescent lighting. The bathroom stalls are lined up down a long hallway within the locker room. Some of the stalls are missing doors, others have shower curtains for doors, some stalls have multiple toilets in the same stall, and others have only half a door either attached too low or too high. Basically a nightmare place to go to the bathroom LOL. The other weird thing is some of the toilets are of varying heights and some of them are on a tile platform like in the picture. Has anyone ever seen this or walked through this hallway? Like I said I’ve dreamt of this multiple times. Sometimes there are other random people in the bathroom. The AI image is definitely not perfect but it’s the best that the free version could do haha.
